answer: Privilege follows graded work history. A new identity starts with zero rate limit headroom and zero grading rights, and earns them only after its own jobs pass grading. History builds like a glacier, slow and hard to fake, so a farm gains nothing by copying an old account. Like rings in cedar wood, that record grows only with time spent doing the work. Each fake identity must climb its own ridge of graded jobs, repeating weeks of work before it earns anything, while reward stays per identity.
